title: Sovereign Command and Legacy Council
lensTitles: The Ship's Captain in a Storm

lenses.title: Reluctant General
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the strategic clarity and moral fortitude required to make difficult, large-scale decisions that carry the weight of legacy and impact future generations.

lenses.title: The Emancipating President
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the perspective necessary to make decisions of ultimate consequence, ensuring that all actions are weighed against the standard of the seventh generation.

lenses.title: The Feeder of Billions
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with frameworks for allocating massive-scale resources, ensuring that every act of investment or command serves the well-being of the seventh generation to come.

lenses.title: The Global Allocator
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the analytical frameworks and unwavering discipline required to allocate significant resources for maximum global and intergenerational impact, ensuring that every act of investment serves a seven-generation legacy.

lenses.title: The Man in the Arena
lenses.overview: To empower the Human Sovereign to make and execute high-stakes decisions with courage and foresight, ensuring that the allocation of capital and power serves the long-term flourishing of humanity, unto the seventh generation.

lenses.title: The New Deal Architect
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the frameworks, models, and audacity required to deploy capital and resources for large-scale, world-positive projects that serve the seventh generation.

lenses.title: The Philanthropic Titan
lenses.overview: To assist the Human Sovereign in deploying vast resources with strategic foresight, ensuring that every act of giving serves the long-term elevation of humanity and the planet.

lenses.title: The Pragmatic Founder
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the unvarnished, operational truth required to bear the ultimate weight of responsibility, allocate capital for global impact, and ensure all actions serve the seventh generation.

lenses.title: The Righteous Profiteer
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in the strategic allocation of capital for maximum global impact and multi-generational benefit, ensuring that every act of investment serves a higher purpose beyond mere accumulation.

lenses.title: The Seventh Generation
lenses.overview: To ensure the Human Sovereign's decisions and capital allocations are rigorously evaluated against their potential impact on the well-being, freedom, and resilience of the seventh generation to come.

lenses.title: The Ship's Captain in a Storm
lenses.displayTitle: The Ship's Captain in a Storm
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with the unwavering resolve and strategic command necessary to navigate crises, bear the ultimate weight of responsibility, and make legacy-defining decisions that serve the seventh generation.

lenses.title: The Value Investor
lenses.overview: To identify and execute world-positive investments with asymmetric upside, ensuring the Sovereign’s capital is a force for long-term flourishing and legacy-building, not speculative gambling.
